front: In what town was the 1969 Woodstock festival actually held?
back: Bethel, New York (on Max Yasgur's dairy farm, not in the town of Woodstock)

front: Whose farm hosted Woodstock 1969?
back: Max Yasgur's (a dairy farm in Bethel, NY)

front: What was Woodstock 1969's billing slogan?
back: "3 Days of Peace & Music" (Aug. 15-18, 1969, it ran into a fourth day)

front: Who closed Woodstock 1969, with a famous take on "The Star-Spangled Banner"?
back: Jimi Hendrix (Monday morning, when most of the crowd had left)

front: Who opened Woodstock 1969, improvising the song "Freedom"?
back: Richie Havens

front: Woodstock '94 was held near which NY town and got what muddy nickname?
back: Saugerties, NY; "Mudstock" (Green Day's set turned into a mud fight)

front: Woodstock '99 took place at what former military site?
back: Griffiss Air Force Base, Rome, NY (it ended in fires, riots and looting)

front: Which 2022 Netflix docuseries covered the Woodstock '99 disaster?
back: Trainwreck: Woodstock '99

front: In 1967, which festival saw Jimi Hendrix set his guitar on fire?
back: Monterey International Pop Festival (Monterey County Fairgrounds, California)

front: Which two music figures organized the Monterey Pop Festival?
back: Lou Adler and John Phillips (of the Mamas & the Papas)

front: Which soul singer's 1967 Monterey Pop set won him a white rock audience months before he died?
back: Otis Redding

front: Which 1969 free concert in California ended in a killing during the Rolling Stones' set?
back: Altamont Speedway Free Festival (Dec. 6, 1969)

front: Which motorcycle club was hired as security at Altamont?
back: The Hells Angels (one stabbed fan Meredith Hunter to death)

front: Which documentary captured the Altamont tragedy?
back: Gimme Shelter (1970, by the Maysles brothers)

front: The 1970 Isle of Wight Festival drew about 600,000 people. Which guitarist gave one of his last concerts there?
back: Jimi Hendrix (his last UK show; he died weeks later)

front: Which singer-songwriter headlined the 1969 Isle of Wight Festival instead of playing Woodstock?
back: Bob Dylan

front: Which two stadiums hosted Live Aid on July 13, 1985?
back: Wembley Stadium (London) and JFK Stadium (Philadelphia)

front: Who organized Live Aid?
back: Bob Geldof and Midge Ure (to raise money for famine relief in Ethiopia)

front: Which band's Live Aid set is often called the greatest live performance ever?
back: Queen

front: Who played both Live Aid concerts, flying across the Atlantic on the Concorde?
back: Phil Collins

front: Live 8 (2005) was timed to coincide with which summit, and which band reunited for it?
back: The G8 summit; Pink Floyd reunited with Roger Waters

front: Which three musicians founded Farm Aid in 1985?
back: Willie Nelson, Neil Young and John Mellencamp (Dave Matthews joined the board in 2001)

front: Which 2017 luxury festival in the Bahamas fell apart, leaving guests with tents and cheese sandwiches?
back: Fyre Festival (Great Exuma)

front: Who co-founded Fyre Festival with rapper Ja Rule and was later imprisoned for fraud?
back: Billy McFarland (sentenced to 6 years)

front: Coachella is held at what venue in which California city?
back: Empire Polo Club, Indio (in the Coachella Valley)

front: In what year was the first Coachella held, and which company promotes it?
back: 1999; Goldenvoice (co-founded the festival with Paul Tollett)

front: What nickname did Beyoncé's 2018 Coachella headlining set get, and what was her concert film?
back: "Beychella"; Homecoming (Netflix, 2019). She was the first Black woman to headline Coachella.

front: Which late rapper appeared as a "hologram" at Coachella 2012?
back: Tupac Shakur (with Dr. Dre and Snoop Dogg)

front: Who replaced a pregnant Beyoncé as a Coachella 2017 headliner?
back: Lady Gaga

front: Since 2012, Coachella has run in what format?
back: Two identical weekends in April ("Weekend 1" and "Weekend 2")

front: In 2023, which Puerto Rican star became Coachella's first Latino solo headliner?
back: Bad Bunny (the same year BLACKPINK became the first Asian act to headline)

front: Name the Coachella 2025 headliners.
back: Lady Gaga, Green Day, Post Malone, plus Travis Scott

front: Who headlined Coachella 2026?
back: Sabrina Carpenter (Fri), Justin Bieber (Sat) and Karol G (Sun) (Anyma also billed as a headliner)

front: Which country festival is held at Coachella's Indio venue the weekend after Coachella?
back: Stagecoach (since 2007)

front: Who headlined Stagecoach 2026?
back: Post Malone, Lainey Wilson and Cody Johnson (headlining Stagecoach for the first time)

front: Who founded Lollapalooza, and in what year?
back: Perry Farrell of Jane's Addiction, in 1991 (it began as a farewell tour for the band)

front: What did Lollapalooza start out as before it became a fixed-site festival?
back: A touring festival that crossed North America (1991-97). It was revived in 2003 and has been in Chicago since 2005.

front: Which Chicago park hosts Lollapalooza?
back: Grant Park

front: Name three Lollapalooza 2025 headliners.
back: Olivia Rodrigo, Sabrina Carpenter, Tyler, the Creator (also Luke Combs, the first country act to close Lolla, and TWICE)

front: Name three Lollapalooza 2026 headliners.
back: Charli XCX, Lorde, the Smashing Pumpkins (also Tate McRae, Olivia Dean, JENNIE, the xx, John Summit)

front: Bonnaroo is held at what site in which Tennessee town?
back: Great Stage Park, Manchester, TN (it began in 2002)

front: Where does the name Bonnaroo come from?
back: New Orleans/Creole slang for "a really good time" (taken from Dr. John's album Desitively Bonnaroo)

front: What are Bonnaroo's two biggest stages called?
back: "What Stage" and "Which Stage"

front: What happened to Bonnaroo 2025?
back: Severe storms got it cancelled after just one day of music (Luke Combs had headlined Thursday night)

front: Name the four main Bonnaroo 2026 headliners.
back: Skrillex, the Strokes, Rufus Du Sol and Noah Kahan

front: Who founded Glastonbury Festival, and on what farm?
back: Michael Eavis, Worthy Farm in Pilton, Somerset, England (first held in 1970). His daughter Emily now co-organizes it.

front: What is Glastonbury's iconic main stage?
back: The Pyramid Stage

front: Whose 2008 booking made him Glastonbury's first major hip-hop headliner, despite criticism from Noel Gallagher?
back: Jay-Z (he opened with "Wonderwall")

front: What is Glastonbury's Sunday-afternoon "Legends slot", and who played it in 2025?
back: A teatime set for veteran stars; Rod Stewart played it in 2025 (Dolly Parton in 2014)

front: Who headlined Glastonbury's Pyramid Stage in 2025?
back: The 1975 (Fri), Neil Young (Sat), Olivia Rodrigo (Sun)

front: Why is there no Glastonbury in 2026?
back: It is a "fallow year" to let the farmland recover (it normally takes one about every five years)

front: Burning Man is held in which desert, and what is its temporary city called?
back: Black Rock Desert, Nevada; Black Rock City

front: Where and when was the first Burning Man held?
back: Baker Beach, San Francisco, 1986 (by Larry Harvey and Jerry James)

front: Which electronic music festival is held each March at Bayfront Park in Miami?
back: Ultra Music Festival (founded in 1999)

front: What does EDC stand for, and where has it been held since 2011?
back: Electric Daisy Carnival; the Las Vegas Motor Speedway (run by Insomniac, founded by Pasquale Rotella)

front: Tomorrowland, the huge EDM festival, takes place in which country and town?
back: Boom, Belgium (since 2005)

front: Austin City Limits Music Festival takes place in which park, and since when?
back: Zilker Park, Austin; since 2002 (named after the long-running PBS TV show)

front: Name three ACL Fest 2025 headliners.
back: Sabrina Carpenter, Doja Cat, Luke Combs (also Hozier, the Strokes, Doechii, John Summit)

front: Name three ACL Fest 2026 (25th anniversary) headliners.
back: Charli XCX, Lorde, Twenty One Pilots (also Rufus Du Sol, the xx, plus Skrillex on Weekend 1 and Kings of Leon on Weekend 2)

front: What do the letters SXSW stand for, and when is it held?
back: South by Southwest; Austin every March (since 1987), mixing music, film and tech

front: At which festival did Bob Dylan famously "go electric" in 1965?
back: Newport Folk Festival (July 25, 1965, in Newport, Rhode Island). The 2024 film A Complete Unknown depicts it.

front: Which promoter founded both the Newport Jazz (1954) and Newport Folk (1959) festivals?
back: George Wein (he also helped launch New Orleans Jazz Fest)

front: Where is the New Orleans Jazz & Heritage Festival held?
back: Fair Grounds Race Course (since 1970, over two weekends from late April to early May)

front: Governors Ball is held in which city, and where is it held now?
back: New York City; Flushing Meadows Corona Park in Queens (it began on Randall's Island in 2011)

front: Who headlined Governors Ball 2025?
back: Tyler, the Creator, Olivia Rodrigo and Hozier

front: Who headlined Governors Ball 2026?
back: Lorde, A$AP Rocky and Stray Kids (the first K-pop group to headline Gov Ball)

front: Outside Lands is held in which park in which city?
back: Golden Gate Park, San Francisco (since 2008)

front: Which Milwaukee lakefront festival calls itself "The World's Largest Music Festival"?
back: Summerfest (since 1968, at Henry Maier Festival Park)

front: Who founded the Vans Warped Tour, the touring punk/emo festival, in 1995?
back: Kevin Lyman (its last full cross-country tour was 2018; it returned for a 30th anniversary in 2025)

front: Who founded Lilith Fair, the all-female festival tour of 1997-99?
back: Sarah McLachlan (revived in 2010)

front: Which couple created the metal festival Ozzfest in 1996?
back: Ozzy and Sharon Osbourne

front: What was Black Sabbath's final concert in July 2025, weeks before Ozzy Osbourne died?
back: "Back to the Beginning" at Villa Park, Birmingham, England

front: Rock in Rio was founded in Rio de Janeiro in what year?
back: 1985 (by Roberto Medina; Queen played the first edition)

front: Roskilde Festival is held in which country, and what tragedy struck it in 2000?
back: Denmark; nine fans died in a crush during Pearl Jam's set

front: Which twin English festivals share a lineup over the August bank holiday weekend?
back: Reading and Leeds (Reading's roots go back to 1961)

front: How did Kurt Cobain take the stage at Reading 1992?
back: In a wheelchair and hospital gown, mocking rumors about his health

front: Primavera Sound is held in which city?
back: Barcelona, Spain (since 2001, at Parc del Forum)

front: Fuji Rock Festival is now held at which Japanese ski resort?
back: Naeba Ski Resort, Niigata (the 1997 debut near Mount Fuji was hit by a typhoon)

front: At which rapper's festival did a crowd crush kill 10 people in Houston in 2021?
back: Travis Scott's Astroworld Festival (Nov. 5, 2021, at NRG Park)

front: Which emo/pop-punk festival launched in Las Vegas in 2022 with My Chemical Romance and Paramore headlining?
back: When We Were Young

front: What does the 1990s jam-band tour H.O.R.D.E. stand for, and who founded it?
back: Horizons of Rock Developing Everywhere; John Popper of Blues Traveler (1992)

front: Name the Coachella 2024 headliners.
back: Lana Del Rey, Tyler, the Creator, Doja Cat (with a reunited No Doubt as a special headliner)

front: Who headlined Glastonbury's Pyramid Stage in 2024?
back: Dua Lipa, Coldplay and SZA
